description: This PHP source file contains utility functions for the installation process of the TestLink open source project, including functions for managing database users, retrieving database schema information, checking PHP extensions, and generating SQL files.

methods.name: getDirSqlFiles
methods.description: Recursively scans directories to find .sql files and returns an array of file paths.

methods.name: getTableList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of table names from the database schema.

methods.name: getUserList
methods.description: Fetches a list of database users depending on the database type.

methods.name: create_user_for_db
methods.description: Creates a database user and grants permissions if the user does not already exist.

methods.name: close_html_and_exit
methods.description: Outputs closing HTML tags and terminates the script.

methods.name: check_pear_modules
methods.description: Checks if required PEAR modules are installed.

methods.name: check_db_loaded_extension
methods.description: Checks if the necessary PHP database extension is loaded.

methods.name: _mysql_make_user
methods.description: Creates a MySQL user with specified privileges.

methods.name: _mysql_assign_grants
methods.description: Assigns privileges to a MySQL user.

methods.name: _postgres_make_user_with_grants
methods.description: Creates a PostgreSQL user and grants privileges.

methods.name: _postgres_assign_grants
methods.description: Assigns privileges to a PostgreSQL user.

methods.name: _mssql_make_user_with_grants
methods.description: Creates a MSSQL user and grants privileges.

methods.name: _mssql_assign_grants
methods.description: Assigns privileges to a MSSQL user.

methods.name: important_reminder
methods.description: Displays a reminder message for configuring mail server settings.
